children: Lion One reported 2.0 m at 44.39 g/t gold, including 0.4 m at 158.76 g/t, in its first underground Zone 500 drill hole. The downhole intercept's true width is unknown; the hole deviated and did not reach its planned depth.
2.0 m at 44.39 g/t gold; true width unknown
High-grade result supports Zone 500 mineralization, but downhole length is not true width and the hole missed two planned lodes.
The very high grade is concentrated in a narrow interval, which may limit its contribution to mineable width.
Hole ended at 474.3 m vs. 555 m planned
Deviation prevented testing the second and third targets, leaving the broader Zone 500 target unconfirmed by this hole.
One of 8 planned holes; 4,480 m total planned
Further drilling could test the zone; subsequent results will determine whether this intercept extends into a larger resource.
Also 6.41 g/t gold over 0.4 m at 81.75 m
The unanticipated mineralization may indicate another structure, but its continuity is not established.

This is an early result from renewed Zone 500 underground exploration, following the prior Zone 500 drilling completed from 2020 to 2022. Completion of the remaining planned holes and assays showing continuity, true widths and results from the missed lodes would be needed to establish a larger catalyst.
from Lion One Metals Limited distributed by GlobeNewswire.
